predictions.rationale: Central class that defines the visual representation and behavior of Collaboration Diagrams in ArgoUML.
Initializes the Collaboration Diagram subsystem; registers diagram type and related actions.
Provides the property panel that lets users inspect and edit Collaboration Diagram settings.
Factory that creates the property panel for Collaboration Diagrams; directly supports editing functionality.
UI action that allows the user to create or open a Collaboration Diagram from menus/toolbars.
Explorer navigation rule linking operations to their Collaboration Diagrams, enhancing traceability.
Explorer rule that navigates from a Collaboration model element to its Collaboration Diagram.
Model–layer representation/identifier for Collaboration Diagrams; used throughout the application.
Provides project-level navigation to Collaboration Diagrams, indirectly supporting the feature.
Explorer rule that connects classifiers to related Collaboration Diagrams, aiding discovery and editing.
